metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for pgmac-net workflows: incident management, ticket workflows, homelab operations, and a portable SRE harness

plugins.name: pgmac-workflows
plugins.description: Homelab workflow skills: live incident triage, post-incident reviews with Infinite How's analysis, GitHub Issue ticket pickup with plan approval gates, plan/design grilling, domain modeling, and context-engineering audits

plugins.name: sre-harness
plugins.description: Portable SRE harness driven by a private site repository: site configuration, and a two-layer service catalog synced from Ansible, ArgoCD and Nagios sources with drift detection
